sentences.en: A plasterer is a craftsman who applies plaster on walls.
sentences.zh: 一位抹灰工是负责在墙上涂抹石膏的工匠。

sentences.en: The skilled craftsman restored the shattered vase piece by piece.
sentences.zh: 这位技艺娴熟的工匠将破碎的花瓶一片片地修复完好。

sentences.en: A good craftsman takes pride in his work.
sentences.zh: 一个优秀的工匠对自己的工作感到自豪。
